answer: Spendable weight should track a public climb of attested work, not the ease of minting a new key. A swarm can scatter fresh names across a meadow of unused addresses, but none of those names can move value until answers and verdict-matched grades have settled on-ledger for many turns. The point that matters is a vertex where established graders keep agreeing on the same record. That history has to age in the open, the way ivory is worked slowly into a hard surface; it cannot be stamped overnight. Until the climb exists, extra identities remain cheap to create and cannot spend.
